description: Safety check for any Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint before an agent or app interacts with it. SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER with a 0-100 score, from mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions that can block or tax sells, liquidity and recent sells, holder concentration and age. Free preview tier: verdict, score and flag counts. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005) and /v1/check ($0.02) add the reasons and evidence. SAFE is not a guarantee and not financial advice.
name: check_solana_token
